passages.provision_quote: (b) without written parental consent make changes to a student's education record 47 regarding a student's gender identity that does not conform with the student's sex.
passages.note: Operative text bars shielding records from parents and requires parental consent to change the record's gender identity; it neither requires schools to notify parents nor governs staff use of names or pronouns, so it shows the parental-access side but no single rung.
Senate concurrence/final passage vote, Hinkins Yea, 22-6-1 (not near-unanimous).

rows.reasoning: Hinkins voted Yea on S.B. 100 (2023), which forbids policies that shield a student's education record from parents and bars changing the record's gender identity "without written parental consent". That places him against "Require staff to keep a student's gender identity from parents" and "Forbid rules that require schools to tell parents", but the bill neither requires schools to notify parents nor requires parental permission before staff use a different name or pronouns, and record access goes beyond "tell parents when parents ask" without matching it clause for clause.
